image_description: A live outdoor concert scene featuring a band performing on an elevated stage. The central figure is a male musician with long blonde hair playing a violin, wearing a black t-shirt and shorts. To his left is another musician in a hat playing guitar, and to the right, a keyboardist. The background consists of large black speaker stacks and trussing structures typical of a festival stage.
